Proofreading Edit History

Source: vignettes/edit-history.Rmd
edit-history.Rmd

This vignette summarises the history of proofreading edits in the Aedes connectome. Every merge or split made in the segmentation is recorded as an operation by the CAVE chunkedgraph, along with a timestamp and the id of the user who made it.

The chunks below need CAVE access and a populated local edit cache. They are only evaluated when the vignette is rebuilt locally; elsewhere saved results are shown instead (see Rerunning this vignette).

Fetching the edit history

aedes:::aedes_all_operations() finds the most recent operation id and then fetches details for every operation up to that point. Results are cached on disk (in rappdirs::user_cache_dir("aedes")), so only new operations are fetched on subsequent calls. The first call takes several hours.

library(aedes)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
ops <- aedes:::aedes_all_operations()

One user account (8041, BANCautomerge) carried out an automated batch of about 75,000 merges over a few days in September 2025, peaking at over 10,000 edits per hour. These corresponded to merges of the nucleus into the main part of the segmentation, based on analysis by Dana Sherman of the nuclear segmentation provided by Zetta. These are excluded so that the plots reflect human proofreading. We also keep only operations that completed successfully (operation_status 0). Operations that remove edges are splits; all others are merges.

auto_users <- 8041
edits <- ops %>%
  filter(!.data$user %in% auto_users, .data$operation_status == 0) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(is.na(.data$removed_edges) |
                         .data$removed_edges == "NA", "merge", "split")) %>%
  arrange(.data$timestamp)

edit_summary <- edits %>%
  summarise(n = n(), users = n_distinct(.data$user),
            first = as.Date(min(.data$timestamp)),
            last = as.Date(max(.data$timestamp)))
edit_summary
#>        n users      first       last
#> 1 219858    39 2025-02-15 2026-10-15

Cumulative edits 

p_cum <- edits %>%
  group_by(.data$type) %>%
  mutate(n = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(.data$timestamp, .data$n, colour = .data$type)) +
  geom_step() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative edits", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
p_cum
ggsave("figures/edits-cumulative.png", p_cum, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 96,
       bg = "white")

Edits per week 

p_week <- edits %>%
  mutate(week = as.Date(cut(.data$timestamp, "week"))) %>%
  count(.data$week, .data$type) %>%
  ggplot(aes(.data$week, .data$n, fill = .data$type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Edits per week", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
p_week
ggsave("figures/edits-weekly.png", p_week, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 96,
       bg = "white")

Rerunning this vignette

To update the figures with the latest edits, rebuild the vignette from the vignettes/ directory on a machine with CAVE access:

withr::with_envvar(c(AEDES_LIVE_VIGNETTES = "true"), {
  rmarkdown::render("edit-history.Rmd", output_dir = tempdir())
})

This tops up the local edit cache and overwrites the PNGs in vignettes/figures/. Then copy the printed edit_summary values into the tidy-saved chunk and commit the updated figures.
